items.title: OpenAI Scholars 2019: Meet our Scholars
items.summary: Our class of eight scholars (out of 550 applicants) brings together collective expertise in literature, philosophy, cell biology, statistics, economics, quantum physics, and business innovation.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI公布了2019年度学者计划的入选名单，旨在汇聚多元背景的人才开展研究。

aiReview.reasonZh: 该内容属于企业人才资助项目介绍，与大语言模型技术无直接关联。
